sample.identification: Invoke-TwitterBot, Chris Campbell / ShmooCon IX PowerShell implant source

method: Static control-flow and effect review of the complete PowerShell source, including decoded constants; sample and payloads were not executed. Atomscan and cleave facts were used as leads.
activation_limits: Loading the file defines Invoke-TwitterBot; invoking the function enters its bot loop.
RandomWait precedes a CheckKillDate guard. The configured end date is 2013-02-16, so this unmodified configuration exits before C2 retrieval today.
Engagement IP and work-hour checks restrict activation. The external-IP fallback references undefined AllowedAddress instead of EngagementIPs.

The dispatcher calls GetSystemCommand, BindShellCommand and KeylogCommand, whereas the defined routines are GetSystem, BindShell and KeyLog. These cases are broken as written. PropagateCommand is not defined.
Some staged download URLs point at GitHub HTML pages, not raw source. No successful download, shell execution, or credential theft is asserted.

verified_paths.behavior: GetLatestTweet retrieves Twitter timeline XML; statuses.status.text becomes LatestTweet; the switch selects RunCommand; a tweet substring is concatenated after cmd.exe /C and passed to Invoke-Expression.
UploadCommand selects a tweet-supplied file, reads bytes, Base64 encodes them and submits them as content through WebClient.UploadValues to Pastebin when under the size cap.

PersistCommand downloads source to ProgramData/cache.db, creates a Startup shortcut and assigns hidden encoded PowerShell that reads and evaluates that file; TargetPath contains the whole command line, which can make the shortcut malformed.

BindShell contains an accepted TCP-client stream to cmd.exe stdin relay and cmd stdout back to the network, with a firewall opening named Windows Update Service. Dispatcher-name defect limits normal activation.
GetSystem enables SeDebugPrivilege, opens LSASS token for impersonation/duplication, duplicates it and assigns it to the current thread. Dispatcher-name defect limits normal activation.
KeyLog polls key state, translates keys, associates foreground-window title and timestamp, and appends results to disk in a background job. Dispatcher-name defect limits normal activation.
CredentialCommand prompts for credentials, extracts the plaintext password and username and writes them to a tweet-selected local path.
ScreenshotCommand copies the virtual screen to a bitmap and saves it to the tweet-selected path.
HTTPS branches install an accepts-all certificate callback; ElevateCommand uses Start-Process -Verb RunAs, which requests user-approved elevation rather than bypassing UAC.

decoded_constants.other_blob: Standard EICAR antivirus test string, decoded by EicarCommand and written to a temporary .com file.

detection_corrections: Require crawler-token boundaries that exclude hyphenated function names.
EICAR reference no longer identifies a WordPress scanner, evidence collector, or threat-signature catalog through that composite.
Disable third-party temp/download/rundll32 cooccurrence rules: wallpaper refresh does not execute a downloaded DLL.
Set third-party JAB variable-assignment-prefix encoding observation to suspicious, not hostile.
Match paste service configuration literals rather than help-comment URLs.
Remove an unreferenced neutral evaluation OR from the objective tier; independently emitted constituent capabilities remain.
Recognize the Twitter timeline API as a neutral endpoint reference.
Correct generic process-object, assembly-module emission, executable-reference, socket accept and stdin-redirection placements and descriptions.
